name: Rishi Techtex Limited
about: Rishi Techtex Limited manufactures and sells plastic woven sacks and shade nets in India and internationally. It offers agro-tech products, such as shade and bird protection nets, weed mats, crop covers, anti-hail nets, windbreakers, and shade sails; geo-textile for ground stabilization, soil and earth reinforcement, pit linings, and soil erosion; and build-tech products, such as architectural membranes, scaffolding nets, awnings and canopies for car parking, hoardings and signages, and floor and wall coverings for concrete reinforcement, facade foundations, interior construction, noise reduction, visual protection, and protection from sunlight and rains applications. The company also provides laminated polypropylene and HDPE woven sacks for the packing of powdered and granulated industrial products, such as fertilizers, cement, plastic polymers, chemicals, bale coverings, tarpaulins, sugar, food grains, salt, and sand. It serves its products to cement, fertilizer, and chemical petrochemical industries. The company was formerly known as Rishi Packers Limited. Rishi Techtex Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.
